title: Dominic and the Cipher
author: E. M. Galloway
blurb: Marguerite Voss, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
